finalText:
I've worked the laptop dock (P-DOC) and monitor (P-MON) backorders. 11 orders now have all their dock and monitor lines allocated, 3 orders are waiting with promise dates, and the order on risk hold was left alone. Each of the 14 customers I worked got one notice (N-1 to N-14).

**Two things that differed from the plan**
- **Today's date:** the plan said 2026-10-05, but the system reports 2026-07-25, so I used that. On that date, update PU-12 applies: orders placed 14 or more days ago (on or before 2026-07-11) go first, oldest first, whatever the customer's tier. PU-9 (gold ranks with platinum) only covered June, so I didn't use it.
- **More stock arrived during the run:** PO-91 (4 docks) and PO-93 (3 monitors) were received while I was working. I gave that stock out under the same priority rules rather than treating those POs as still on the way. In total that was 11 docks and 7 monitors, and both are now at 0 in stock.

**Order of priority:**
1. Orders placed on or before 2026-07-11: O-5201, O-5202, O-5203, O-5204.
2. Platinum: O-5206 (ship-complete), O-5207 (ship-complete).
3. Gold: O-5208, O-5209, O-5210.
4. Standard: O-5211, O-5212, O-5213, O-5214, O-5215.

**Allocated (ready to ship)**

| Order | Line | Quantity | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| O-5201 | L1 | 2 docks | |
| O-5202 | L1 | 1 monitor | |
| O-5202 | L2 | 1 dock | |

| O-5207 | L2 | 1 monitor | |

| O-5209 | L1 | 2 docks | |
| O-5210 | L1 | 1 dock | |
| O-5211 | L1 | 1 dock | |
| O-5212 | L1 | 1 monitor | |
| O-5215 | L1 | 1 dock | Got the last dock; O-5213 needed 2 and couldn't be filled |

**Still waiting, with promise dates**
- **O-5206 L1 (dock) and L2 (USB-C hub): 2026-08-14 for both.** The order is ship-complete and there are no hubs in stock, so neither line could be allocated. The dock is covered by PO-95 (due 2026-08-14) and the hub by PO-90 (due 2026-08-06). Both lines get the later date.
- **O-5213 L1 (2 docks): 2026-08-14**, from PO-95.
- **O-5214 L1 (1 monitor): 2026-08-19**, from PO-97.

Every waiting line is covered by a purchase order still in transit.

**Held:** O-5205 (1 dock) is on risk hold. It got no allocation, no promise date and no notice.
